summary: Iter 6 (AUD currency switch) tested. Backend: 12/12 pytest green with new currency='aud' assertions on both monthly & lifetime checkout sessions (payment_transactions stores currency='aud', amount=3.99 / amount=24.99). Frontend: /premium, /settings, /collections/budget, /collections/meal-plan all show correct A$ pricing — verified contains A$3.99, A$24.99, A$4, A$2, A$28, A$30, Melbourne & Sydney testimonials; ZERO bare USD '$' or GBP '£' on those pages. No mobile (414x896) overflow on /premium, /settings, /collections/budget, /collections/meal-plan. PaywallTrigger.jsx parent-psych copy & lifetime CTA confirmed via source. REGRESSION: cheese-sim outcome flagged in iter-5 is NOT flaky — reproduced again. Real UX bug: ctrl-take-out button (y=861 on a 896 viewport) is covered by the fixed bottom nav (z-30); a centred click lands on nav-recipes instead. When the button is scrolled into view first, outcome renders correctly (outcome, outcome-title='PERFECT!', ctrl-share, ctrl-reset all present; URL stays /simulator).

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile 414x896 the ctrl-take-out button renders at y≈861 (bottom-nav covers y≈840–896 at z-30). User tapping the button or any automation clicking at its centre hits the bottom-nav 'Recipes' item beneath it and navigates to /recipes instead of finishing the sim. Reproduced 2/2. After scroll_into_view → outcome panel renders correctly with PERFECT result.

issues: Bottom nav (fixed, z-30) overlaps ctrl-take-out on 414x896 — main has pb-28 (112px) which is not enough once phase-readout pushes controls down. Consider bumping main pb to pb-32 or making controls sticky above the nav.

verified_backend.test_premium_api.py: 12/12 pass (2.87s). test_checkout_monthly: amount=3.99 currency=aud package=monthly. test_checkout_lifetime: amount=24.99 currency=aud package=lifetime. payment_transactions persists currency='aud' for both.

cheese_sim_regression_rca.root_cause: ctrl-take-out button bounding box (x=20, y=861, w=374, h=57) sits underneath the fixed bottom nav (`fixed bottom-0 z-30`). The nav is the top-z element at that y range, so any click/tap at the button centre (~x=207, y=890) dispatches to the nav item beneath (nav-recipes at centre slot of 5). React-Router navigates to /recipes; the underlying ctrl-take-out onClick never fires; outcome state is never set.
cheese_sim_regression_rca.evidence: After calling btn.scroll_into_view_if_needed() (moves button up ~22px out from under the nav) and clicking without force=True, the outcome panel renders with [data-testid=outcome], outcome-title='PERFECT!', ctrl-share, ctrl-reset; URL stays /simulator. With force=True click at original y=890 → URL=/recipes.
cheese_sim_regression_rca.suggested_fix: Either (a) increase `pb-28` on <main> in Layout.jsx to `pb-32` or `pb-36` to keep the last control above the bottom nav, OR (b) add `position: sticky; bottom: 80px; z-index: 31` to the active stage-5 control so the button is always visible above the nav, OR (c) wrap the controls block in a container that auto-scrolls when stage transitions to 5.
cheese_sim_regression_rca.iter5_note: Main agent's manual-retest claim of 'flaky' was incorrect — likely passed manually because manual scroll repositions the button. Automated viewport-fixed clicks hit the bug deterministically.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Bottom-nav overlaps stage-5 ctrl-take-out on mobile — bump <main> bottom padding in Layout.jsx (pb-28 → pb-36) or make the stage-5 control sticky-above-nav. Affects real users on 414x896-class phones, not just automation.
Optional: re-test sim flow after fix to confirm outcome panel + ctrl-share + ctrl-reset still render and URL stays /simulator.
critical_code_review_comments: Currency change is clean — backend PACKAGES dict is the single source of truth and the existing /checkout/session route picks up `currency` from PACKAGES; no hardcoded currency elsewhere.
Frontend AUD text is consistent: A$ prefix used everywhere (Paywall, Settings, PaywallTrigger, collections data).
PREMIUM_BADGES constant is exported but no longer imported anywhere — dead export. Either wire it into /achievements or remove to avoid future drift like the £2 leftover I just fixed.
Layout.jsx pb-28 is not adaptive to stage-5 controls that grow taller (phase-readout + larger CTA). Consider an env(safe-area-inset-bottom)-aware bottom spacer instead.
